name: Tyler Adams
description: 16-year-old high school student in Arizona asking where he has to live after his parents separate.
style: young, nervous, informal, asks if kids get a say in court
quirks: Asks if a judge will force him to live with his dad or if he can choose his mom

hidden_case.goal: Understand minor child's legal voice/wishes in Arizona child custody proceedings
facts: Parents separated 2 months ago in Maricopa County, Arizona
Father filed for sole legal decision-making and primary physical custody
16-year-old child strongly desires to reside primarily with mother near his school
documents: Copy of custody petition filed by father
